title: Asymptotic uncorrelations between functions with squarefull kernel and functions of invariant average
summary: In 1986, Ivić and Tenenbaum introduced arithmetic functions with squarefull kernel, which are also called $s$-functions. Later, Erdős and Ivić gave an asymptotic estimate on the shifted convolution sums of $s$-functions. Recently, Bergelson and Richter studied the orbits along the prime Omega function in a uniquely ergodic topological dynamical system and established a new dynamical generalization of the prime number theorem (PNT).
